👩‍🏫 Faculty Performance Summary
How this is calculated: Only regular students are counted (backlog/repeaters excluded). For BCA, each faculty's pass % is based on their section only. Overall Pass % = average of pass % across all their subjects. Subject Pass % = students who passed ÷ students who appeared × 100. Students marked Absent are not counted.

🧍 Missing Exam Writers
📊 True Count — regular students per course/campus/sem
Odd semesters (I·III·V) and even semesters (II·IV·VI) compared side by side. A ⚠ flags a semester that's 0 or under half its strongest sibling for that same course+campus — usually means that class still needs uploading. Regular students only (backlog/repeat-only entries excluded — see note below).
🔎 Semester-pair comparison — who's missing
Each pair below compares consecutive semesters (I→II, III→IV, V→VI) for the selected course + campus above — regular students present in the earlier semester's roll but not found (by URN) in the later one. Backlog/repeat-only entries are excluded on both sides, so this only flags someone who wrote a full exam and then genuinely has no record the next term — not a student who happened to also be repeating an old paper. Click a pair to expand the list; photo, name, USN, and the section they were in.
📋 Subject Performance — Faculty & Class Breakdown
One row per subject + section (BCA sections A/B/C are separate rows since they can have different faculty; BBA/BCom have no section split). Click any column header to sort; click again to reverse. Excel export downloads exactly what's shown below, respecting the chips, exceptions, and backlog toggle.
🚫 Excluded Subjects
Subjects listed here are hidden from Subject Performance (and its Excel export) — typically 50-mark papers, self-study/project work, or language electives that don't compare meaningfully against core papers. Add or remove any subject at any time; changes save to Firebase and apply for everyone.

📥 Import Merit Snapshot
Safe mode: adds or updates just this one student in the existing Course/Batch/Pair snapshot below. Everyone else already in it is left untouched.
One student per line — URN, Name, Father, Relation, Phone, Pct Sem A, Pct Sem B
Comma or tab separated. Father / Relation / Phone may be left empty, but keep the commas. The last two values must be the two percentages.
⚠ Replaces the ENTIRE snapshot for this Course + Batch + Pair. Use Add/Update One above to add a single student without touching the rest.
Exactly one line — URN, Name, Father, Relation, Phone, Pct Sem A, Pct Sem B. If this URN already exists in the snapshot, it's updated in place; otherwise it's added.
🖼 Photo Manager — student uploads
Student uploads go live automatically. Use Allow re-upload to give a locked-out student another attempt on their existing link, or Remove photo to take a bad one down. You can always add a photo yourself from the 📷 button on any row — that has no limit.
